Team / Michael —

Quick security summary after review of AtlasFin's TOMs markup and Priyom's proposals:

- BYOK support: Confirmed. Redwood can support BYOK where the customer controls root key material. Operationally we will accept an RSA/ECC key uploaded to the customer's KMS (cloud or on-prem connector).
- Escrow: we prefer a sealed escrow model with a neutral custodian for emergency recovery. The escrow release process must be strictly gated (legal hold + two internal approvers + customer sign-off). We will not hold any master keys in plaintext.
- HSM: For keys that require hardware protection, Redwood will use HSM-backed key wrapping for any Redwood-managed envelopes. Root keys under BYOK remain under customer control; we recommend wrapping application keys with a customer root.
- Export controls: propose an explicit clause: "Key material will be stored only in regions agreed in writing. Any transfer outside these regions requires prior written consent from the customer and compliance review."

I've attached a TOMs extract (TOMs_v2.pdf) that shows the updated KMS diagram, rotation policy, and access matrix. If AtlasFin can confirm the regions for storage and whether they require BYOK for all environments (prod vs. staging), we can finalize.

Best,
